about: 2.57 strike choice for option-buying rules (Mandeep, 11 Nov 2026: 'go ahead' on choosing strikes by premium; the Lab could only buy at the money). A Lab rule may name a strike; without one it buys the ATM option exactly as before (old rules and their results unchanged). choices: name -> {steps: strikes away from ATM, + = out of the money (higher strike for a call, lower for a put), - = in the money} or {premium_pct: the strike on the out-of-the-money side whose price is nearest this % of the index (0.15% of Nifty 25,000 = about Rs 37; of Bank Nifty 57,000 = about Rs 85)}. exits: the exits the Lab prices for every strike (the bar table grows by choices x exits columns, so only these). syms: where other strikes are priced (index option chains are deep; stock chains are thin). share: how often the random search tries a non-ATM strike.

lowprem.words: the out-of-the-money strike priced nearest 0.15% of the index
